name: CowAgent
description: Always-on AI assistant that plans tasks, controls the computer and external services, and works across the web and major IM platforms.
whatItDoes: Plans and executes tasks proactively, creates and runs skills, and keeps a personal knowledge base and long-term memory. Runs continuously on a personal computer or server.
howItWorks: Messages arrive through channels, an agent core reasons over memory, knowledge, tools and skills, and pluggable model providers generate the output. A web console on port 9899 configures models, channels and skills, and a `cow` CLI controls the service.

requirements.name: Docker
requirements.description: Only for the Docker Compose deployment
